🎬 Roald Dahl’s Matilda the Musical (2022)

Matilda the Musical follows Matilda Wormwood, an extraordinary young girl with a brilliant mind, a vivid imagination, and a love for reading. Growing up with selfish parents who fail to appreciate her intelligence, Matilda finds comfort in books and dreams of a better life. When she begins attending Crunchem Hall, she encounters the terrifying headmistress Miss Trunchbull, whose cruel rules make life miserable for the students. With encouragement from her kindhearted teacher Miss Honey and her new friends, Matilda discovers her courage and extraordinary abilities. Filled with unforgettable songs, magical moments, and heartfelt storytelling, the film celebrates kindness, bravery, friendship, and standing up for what is right.

🎭 Genre: Musical • Fantasy • Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 57m • PG

🎥 Director: Matthew Warchus

✍️ Writer: Dennis Kelly

🎵 Music & Lyrics: Tim Minchin

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Roald Dahl's Matilda the Musical, or simply Matilda the Musical, is a 2022 musical fantasy comedy film directed by Matthew Warchus and written by Dennis Kelly. It is based on the stage musical by Tim Minchin and Kelly, which in turn was based on Matilda by Roald Dahl. The second film adaptation of the novel, after Matilda (1996), it stars Alisha Weir as the title character, with Lashana Lynch, Stephen Graham, Andrea Riseborough, Sindhu Vee, and Emma Thompson.
